title: Explicit affine base-change module and target coordinates
statement: Let A to D be a map of commutative rings, M an unbounded A-module complex, K a derived object on Spec A, e:Q(tilde M) isomorphic to K, and assume the canonical pullback counit on tilde M is invertible. Define the D-linear target coordinate b:H^i(D tensor_A M) isomorphic to Gamma H^i(Lg' *K) by exact tilde homology, the termwise tensor-pullback isomorphism, inverse universal counit, and e. Further let R,A,B,D be commutative rings with R-algebra structures on A,B and a tensor-algebra structure on D, and let m be a BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel for M. Define U by extending m.cohomology i from A tensor_R B to D. Given phi:A to D equal to the composite tensor-algebra map, define a:U to V as m.localizedComparison i, transport the target complex along that equality, followed by any specified target cohomology coordinate b. These are actual composites of existing maps, not arbitrary existential witnesses.
